catalog.scope: Manual accounting writer definitions and document authority only, no payment or mutation

ledger_triggers.name: aa_ca_capture_tournament_charge_entitlement
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER aa_ca_capture_tournament_charge_entitlement AFTER INSERT ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.tournament_id IS NOT NULL) AND (new.from_type = 'player_wallet'::text) AND (new.to_type = 'prize_liability'::text))) EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_capture_tournament_charge_entitlement()

ledger_triggers.name: ab_ca_chip_store_declared
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER ab_ca_chip_store_declared BEFORE INSERT ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_chip_store_declared()

ledger_triggers.name: accounting_transfer_document
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER accounting_transfer_document AFTER INSERT ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.status = 'posted'::text) AND ((new.from_type = ANY (ARRAY['union_wallet'::text, 'union_bank'::text, 'club_treasury'::text, 'player_wallet'::text, 'agent_wallet'::text])) OR ((new.from_type = 'settlement_suspense'::text) AND (new.category = 'rakeback'::text))) AND (new.to_type = ANY (ARRAY['union_wallet'::text, 'union_bank'::text, 'club_treasury'::text, 'player_wallet'::text, 'agent_wallet'::text])))) EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_accounting_transfer_document_on_insert()

ledger_triggers.name: cancelled_tournament_evidence_is_immutable
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER cancelled_tournament_evidence_is_immutable BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_cancelled_tournament_evidence_is_immutable()

ledger_triggers.name: trg_ca_append_only
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_ca_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_journal_append_only()

ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_ca_chip_ledger_enrich BEFORE INSERT ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_chip_ledger_enrich()

ledger_triggers.name: trg_chip_ledger_performed_by
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_chip_ledger_performed_by BEFORE INSERT ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_chip_ledger_performed_by()

ledger_triggers.name: zz_ca_attested_day_is_restated_del
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER zz_ca_attested_day_is_restated_del AFTER DELETE ON public.chip_ledger REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_attested_day_is_restated()

ledger_triggers.name: zz_ca_attested_day_is_restated_upd
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER zz_ca_attested_day_is_restated_upd AFTER UPDATE ON public.chip_ledger REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_rows NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_attested_day_is_restated()

ledger_triggers.name: zz_ca_escrow_overlay_leg
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER zz_ca_escrow_overlay_leg AFTER INSERT ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.to_type = 'prize_liability'::text) AND ((new.category = 'overlay'::text) OR ((new.category = 'correction'::text) AND (new.from_type = ANY (ARRAY['union_bank'::text, 'club_treasury'::text])))))) EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_escrow_on_overlay_leg()

ledger_triggers.name: zz_ca_escrow_reserve_leg
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER zz_ca_escrow_reserve_leg AFTER INSERT ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.category = ANY (ARRAY['spin_entry'::text, 'spin_prize'::text]))) EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_escrow_on_reserve_leg()

ledger_triggers.name: zz_ca_escrow_seat_transfer_leg
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER zz_ca_escrow_seat_transfer_leg AFTER INSERT ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.to_type = 'prize_liability'::text) AND (new.idempotency_key ~~ 'tourney:%:seat:%:pool_transfer'::text))) EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_escrow_on_seat_transfer_leg()

ledger_triggers.name: zz_ca_issuance_leg_is_registered
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER zz_ca_issuance_leg_is_registered AFTER INSERT ON public.chip_ledger DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.from_type = ANY (ARRAY['system_mint'::text, 'system_burn'::text, 'issuance_reserve'::text, 'chip_retirement'::text])) OR (new.to_type = ANY (ARRAY['system_mint'::text, 'system_burn'::text, 'issuance_reserve'::text, 'chip_retirement'::text])))) EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_issuance_leg_is_registered()

ledger_triggers.name: zz_chip_ledger_key_is_claimed_once
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER zz_chip_ledger_key_is_claimed_once BEFORE INSERT ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION zz_chip_ledger_key_is_claimed_once()

ledger_triggers.name: zz_freeze_guard
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER zz_freeze_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_refuse_while_frozen()
